attempt_disposition.contemporaneous_narrative_boundary: PR or conversation observations may be retained with attribution, but cannot replace missing raw events or establish final counters, outputs, termination cause, or independent replay.

bounded_prevention.existing_behavior: run_campaign atomically publishes and fsyncs report.json after every returned episode, with no-overwrite protection. The final campaign manifest is published only after all tasks return.
bounded_prevention.next_attempt_requirement: Use a fresh workspace evidence directory outside /tmp, retain completed reports and the original freeze, and persist/archive available raw evidence before an execution environment is discarded.
bounded_prevention.remaining_boundary: _supervise retains the active episode frames in memory. Completed reports outside /tmp reduce loss on temporary-directory reset but do not make the active episode restart-safe or guarantee workspace persistence.

process_check.method: Read executable arguments and command names from the available /proc PID namespace; exclude checker and ancestor shells.
process_check.scope_limitation: The available PID namespace is the current command sandbox. This is not proof that the former session or another execution namespace has no processes.

not_permitted_by_this_review: Recreate or overwrite attempt-5 artifacts as if they were its original outputs.
Reuse the attempt-5 identity or silently rerun its tasks.
Modify or clean up historical runtime paths or deduplicate historical assets based on the namespace-limited process check.
Claim historical completion/replay, trained admission, milestone completion, production readiness, or merge approval.
historical_hold_disposition.permitted: Review and integrate new source, validate it, and prepare a distinctly identified future campaign using fresh paths, a new source/model freeze, and unchanged qualification gates.
historical_hold_disposition.rationale: The frozen attempt lacks its raw outputs and required runtime assets in the recovered workspace. The historical finish/replay condition cannot currently be performed. Source work can proceed without modifying the frozen specification or representing missing evidence as success.
historical_hold_disposition.unsatisfied_condition: Finish all attempt-5 tasks and both sequential replays before releasing the freeze.

required_followup: Fresh independent review and meaningful tests for any reconstructed Coder preparer source; historical review scores are not portable to changed bytes.
New trained-payload provenance and strict zero-generation admission before any new live campaign.
Preserve the existing corpus, ordered tasks, one attempt per task, limits, grammar, policy, verifiers and acceptance gates.
Retain all historical failed campaigns and attempt-5 evidence-loss disposition; no automatic retry or best-output selection.
Keep PR 118 unmerged and milestone 7 open until actual predeclared qualification and final-source CI pass.
scope: Evidence availability and operational freeze disposition after a frozen session; no reconstructed output, model admission, source implementation acceptance or live qualification.
score_boundary: This operational evidence review does not assign an implementation score or waive the required independent source score of at least 9.5.
